top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient has a high white cell count, both preoperatively and postoperatively, indicating leukocytosis, and also shows signs of hypoxia, oliguria, and metabolic acidosis, which could indicate sepsis.
The patient presents with hypoxia, bilateral ground glass shadowing on the lung parenchyma, and requires mechanical ventilation, which are indicative of acute respiratory distress syndrome.
